claims.text: The tweets were filtered using names of target clubs and annotated for stance as Favor or Against.
A total of 700 tweets were annotated, with an equal number of tweets in favor of and against each target.
The annotation process did not include tweets where the target was not explicitly mentioned or those classified as Neither.
The annotated dataset is publicly available in CSV format, containing tweet IDs, target names, and stance.
